name: The Tanakh & Pirkei Avot
translation: Hebrew Scripture & Mishnah Ethics — Traditional Translation

chapters.name: The Shema & The Commandments
chapters.subtitle: The foundational declaration of faith and devotion

verses.text: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
verses.original: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד
verses.transliteration: Shema Yisrael Adonai Eloheinu Adonai Echad.

verses.text: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your might.
verses.original: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ
verses.transliteration: V'ahavta et Adonai Elohecha b'chol l'vavcha...

verses.text: You shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the Lord.
He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
verses.original: הִגִּיד לְךָ אָדָם מַה־טּוֹב וּמָה־יְהוָה דּוֹרֵשׁ מִמְּךָ כִּי אִם־עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וְהַצְנֵעַ לֶכֶת עִם־אֱלֹהֶיךָ

chapters.name: Pirkei Avot (Ethics of the Fathers)
chapters.subtitle: Ancient rabbinic wisdom on duty, justice, and character

verses.text: Shimon the Righteous used to say: Upon three things the world stands: upon the Torah, upon divine service, and upon acts of loving-kindness.
verses.original: שִׁמְעוֹן הַצַּדִּיק הָיָה אוֹמֵר, עַל שְׁלשָׁה דְבָרִים הָעוֹלָם עוֹמֵד, עַל הַתּוֹרָה וְעַל הָעֲבוֹדָה וְעַל גְּמִילוּת חֲסָדִים

verses.text: Hillel said: If I am not for myself, who will be for me? And being only for myself, what am I? And if not now, when?
verses.original: הוּא הָיָה אוֹמֵר, אִם אֵין אֲנִי לִי, מִי לִי. וּכְשֶׁאֲנִי לְעַצְמִי, מָה אֲנִי. וְאִם לֹא עַכְשָׁיו, אֵימָתַי
verses.transliteration: Im ein ani li, mi li? U'chshenani l'atzmi, mah ani? V'im lo achshav, eimatai?

verses.text: Rabbi Tarfon said: It is not your duty to finish the work, but neither are you at liberty to neglect it.
verses.original: הוּא הָיָה אוֹמֵר, לֹא עָלֶיךָ הַמְּלָאכָה לִגְמֹר, וְלֹא אַתָּה בֶן חוֹרִין לִבָּטֵל מִמֶּנָּה

verses.text: Ben Zoma said: Who is wise? One who learns from every person. Who is strong? One who subdues his own impulses. Who is rich? One who rejoices in his portion.
verses.original: בֶּן זוֹמָא אוֹמֵר, אֵיזֶהוּ חָכָם, הַלּוֹמֵד מִכָּל אָדָם. אֵיזֶהוּ גִבּוֹר, הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ. אֵיזֶהוּ עָשִׁיר, הַשָּׂמֵחַ בְּחֶלְקוֹ
